items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: He played trombone in that band... he used to kid me and tell me about my being the youngest one in the group.

ctx.x: And we would rehearse down at the house and the people would gather around. There was an old man playing trombone, uh, Mr. Joe Petit, he was a very old man.
